creator: adamstewartmarketing
title: Build a 'boring business' booking app in Emergent with one prompt (jet-ski hire with calendar, Stripe deposit and slot-locking) and run the numbers to $10k/month in Australia; comment 'emergent' for five prompts

tools.name: Emergent
tools.detail: app.emergent.sh; agentic app builder that writes frontend, backend, database and Stripe checkout and deploys; UI shows 'Delegated to Design Agent', 'Builder Fest: Participate & win up to $100K'

tools.name: Stripe Checkout
tools.detail: Deposits in test mode, then flip to live

claims: To make $10k/month from zero in Australia he would start a boring business, not an AI startup

Five boring businesses: jet-ski hire (two skis + trailer), beach bootcamp selling 10-packs, takeaway shop that stops paying 30% to delivery apps, made-to-order merch brand (run three at once), gutter cleaner quoting from address with no callback

Prompt for jet-ski hire: customers pick an available date on a calendar and pay a deposit via Stripe to lock it; booked dates show unavailable to everyone else immediately so two people cannot pay for the same slot; include a simple admin view for the ramp employee
Emergent agents write frontend, backend, database and Stripe checkout and put it live
Test from two phones: the date should go grey on the other phone if the lock holds; then flip Stripe from test to live
Numbers: two skis at $150/hour, 7 days a week ~= $2,100/week, four weekends ~= $8,400; add a third ski to clear $10,000; one employee runs the ramp, the app runs the diary
how_to_steps: Pick a boring business from the five
Paste the one-line booking prompt (calendar, Stripe deposit, immediate slot lock, admin view)
Let Emergent agents build frontend, backend, DB, Stripe checkout and deploy
Test the double-booking lock from two phones, then switch Stripe from test to live
on_screen_only: Emergent builder UI with 'Explore Custom Agents' and 'What will you build today?'

Full prompt text: 'Build a jet ski booking web app for Australia. Customers pick an available date on a calendar and pay a deposit via Stripe to lock it. Booked dates show as unavailable to everyone else immediately so two people cannot pay for the same slot. Include a simple admin view for the ramp employee.'

Emergent chat at app.emergent.sh/chat (project 'jetski-booking-3'): 'Agent asked a question -- Answered', 'Use Stripe Checkout for deposits in test mode.', 'Delegated to Design Agent', 'Design Agent is running...', Pause agent button

Illustrative cards: 'Jet ski hire -- Two skis and a trailer' with booking calendar; 'Takeaway shop -- Stop paying 30% to delivery apps'; 'Gutter cleaner -- No callback. Enter address -> Instant quote -> Quote ready'

Built app 'Aussie WaveRider': confirmation 'You're on the water' with booking ID, date 2026-09-07, slot 08:00-12:00, deposit paid $100 AUD; landing 'Pick a date. Pick a slot. Lock it with your deposit.' with availability grid; 'Weekend numbers' dashboard showing $8,379 projected ('$2,100 x 4 weekends = $8,400')
cta: Comment 'emergent' for all five business prompts

relevance.why: Side-hustle content (like the Readdy/local-business pitches Haji has liked) aimed at Australians. The reusable bit is the booking-with-deposit prompt spec and the two-phone race-condition test, which any of Haji's booking-type apps should include. Emergent is a Claude Code competitor, not his stack.

implement_score.why: Not worth switching tools. Worth copying the prompt's requirement list (immediate slot lock, deposit, admin view, two-device test) into Haji's own spec template for any scheduling feature built in Claude Code.

verify: Does Emergent really deploy Stripe live checkout and a database with one prompt, and what does it cost?
Is the double-booking lock actually transactional or just UI state?
Is the creator affiliated with Emergent (Builder Fest banner, comment-for-prompts funnel)?

gap.what: Variation of the liked 'build a site for a local business' side-hustle genre; only new elements are the Emergent builder and the explicit slot-lock/deposit spec plus two-phone race test.
